precedence: business_rules_addendum overrides older phase0/domain rules when there is a clash
domain_intro_latest is the corrected domain background
the database is authoritative for actual enum values

cash_flow_signs.storage: cash_flow.amount is already signed in the DB
cash_flow_signs.do_not: do not re-sign stored amounts with CASE inflow THEN amount ELSE -amount

withdrawal_presentation.rule: when the question asks for total withdrawal or amount withdrawn, present a positive magnitude
withdrawal_presentation.net_flow_exception: net cash flow keeps the stored sign convention

ranking_tie_break.rule: top-k/bottom-k rankings must add a deterministic secondary id key
ranking_tie_break.pattern: ORDER BY score direction, entity_id ASC

missing_scores_in_rankings.rule: exclude NULL scores from highest/lowest rankings
missing_scores_in_rankings.pattern: WHERE score IS NOT NULL before ranking

uniform_averaging_grain.rule: when grouping by investor attributes, compute every averaged metric per investor first, then AVG across investors
uniform_averaging_grain.avoid: do not mix per-investor-first averages with row-pooled averages in the same grouped result

rules: do not join tables the question does not ask for
use LEFT JOIN from investor profile for optional child metrics
express every condition the question states

allocation_concentration.definition: allocation concentration for an investor is MAX(allocation_pct), the largest single-sector share
allocation_concentration.cohort_formula: per-investor MAX(allocation_pct), then AVG across investors
allocation_concentration.wording: state as average of each investor's largest single-sector allocation percent

normalized_indexes.quantitative_burden_index: 0-100 equal-weight min-max index of SHORT, inverse GAIN, inverse NCF, risk_pressure_score
normalized_indexes.transaction_rebalance_index: 0-100 equal-weight min-max index of NCF, REB, SCEN_delta_sum
normalized_indexes.temporal_pressure_index: 0-100 equal-weight min-max index of NCF(period), REB, inverse AVGSHORT, SCEN_delta_sum

composite_scores.temporal_ncf_period: use the period stated in the question; if no period is stated, mark the question incomplete

returns_pct_weighting.average_return: equal-weighted AVG(returns_pct), normally per investor first when grouped by investor attributes
returns_pct_weighting.portfolio_or_value_weighted_return: weight by current_value or cost only when explicitly requested

rules: never aggregate ids, dates, or enum labels as numeric measures
0-100 scores such as goal_match_pct are averaged, not summed

proportion_denominators.rule: share/proportion of investors uses the full cohort denominator
proportion_denominators.missing_metric_policy: NULL metric counts as not meeting the threshold, not as removed from denominator

xirr.storage_transform: for XIRR only, negate stored cash_flow.amount to investor-pocket convention
xirr.plausibility_warning: XIRR > 25% must be flagged for data quality review
xirr.cohort_rule: compute XIRR per investor; do not pool cash flows across investors
